name: Undefined Identifier
description: A program references a symbol that cannot be resolved in the accessible scope.

name: Type Mismatch
description: A value does not satisfy the type required by an operation, assignment, or declaration.

name: Null Access
description: Code attempts to access a member or value through an absent object reference.

name: Index Out of Bounds
description: An index lies outside the valid bounds of a sequence.

name: Missing Module
description: A required module, package, or assembly cannot be resolved.

name: Invalid Syntax
description: Source text cannot be parsed according to the language grammar.

name: Permission Denied
description: An operation is rejected because the current identity lacks permission.

name: File Not Found
description: A requested file or path cannot be located.

name: Connection Refused
description: A remote endpoint rejected a connection attempt.

name: Stack Overflow
description: Call-stack growth exceeded the available execution stack.

name: Integer Overflow
description: A numeric operation exceeded the representable range.

name: Borrow Violation
description: An ownership or borrowing rule prevents unsafe aliased access.

name: Lifetime Violation
description: A reference may outlive the data it refers to.

name: Deadlock
description: All participating execution paths are blocked waiting for progress.

name: Race Condition
description: Correctness depends on unpredictable execution order.

name: Invalid Cast
description: A value cannot be converted to the requested target type.

name: Missing Property
description: A requested member is absent from an object or type.

name: Duplicate Declaration
description: A symbol was declared more than once where uniqueness is required.
